evidence.claim: Cardholder confirmed the $111.92 purchase of 5 December as their own and also recognised both 2 December online purchases ($25.04 and $99.94, the latter from a work computer), explaining the 'New' device flag on 3507797.
Flagged txn is in-person, product W, region 264 - the card's dominant profile: 2,215/2,431 in-person, 2,220 txns in region 264 over 180 days, mean amount $124.74 vs this $111.92 (amount_z -0.07).

The card was used in region 264 on every one of the eight days 2016-11-28 through 2016-12-05, and 27 home-region transactions occurred within 48h - continuous normal home activity, not a clone or trip signature.
No card-testing runs and no just-under-$500 runs detected in the window; only 2 online txns in the episode, both customer-confirmed.

None of the five rare shared device profiles (cards_all_time 5-56) linked to the confirmed-fraud cards C06224-K2, C01155-K2, C05704-K2 etc. appear on any transaction of this card in the episode window; the only devices seen here are a 'Found' MacOS profile and a generic Windows/chrome string.
Region 264 shows 18 newcomer cards in 7 days with a 0.17 fraud-history rate vs 0.10 base rate, but C09933-K2 is not a newcomer there (2,220 prior txns) and is not among the flagged newcomer IDs.
Prior cleared case on this same card (CC-0657) shows the model scoring a $1,769.94 purchase at 0.90 that the cardholder confirmed; high scores on this account have previously been false positives.
Five nearest semantic matches (CC-0954, CC-1114, CC-4349, CC-5448, CC-0489), all score-triggered alerts at 0.82-0.95, were all cleared after customer confirmation.
Policy R3: when the customer confirms the transaction, recommend CLOSE_NO_FRAUD and note the confirmation in the case file.

case.summary: Case HHG-007 was opened purely on a real-time model score of 0.87 for transaction 3514948 ($111.92, in-person, region 264). The transaction matches the cardholder's dominant behaviour almost exactly: 91% of their history is in-person product W, region 264 accounts for 2,220 of 2,431 transactions, and the amount is 0.9x their mean. The cardholder has now confirmed the purchase and also confirmed the only two online transactions in the window, including the $99.94 from a work computer that carried a 'New' device flag. C09933-K2 does have a heavy confirmed-fraud history (CC-0104, CC-1524, CC-2834, CC-3821), but every one of those episodes involved out-of-region card-present use or mixed-channel activity, neither of which is present here; and the card also has a prior cleared high-score alert (CC-0657). No rare shared device profile touches this episode. Treat as legitimate: close with no fraud, retain the case record given the account's history.
